newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo stocks up in early trade inspired by Wall St.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo stocks up in early trade inspired by Wall St.

text.p: Tokyo stocks firmed slightly in early Monday morning trade, inspired by a new record close on Wall Street on Friday and by Nikkei futures, which closed higher in Chicago than in Osaka, brokers said.
They said another encouraging factor was the yen, which following the Group of Seven (G7) summit meeting was at about 115 yen to the dollar, compared with about 114 yen late last week.
After 18 minutes of trade, the Nikkei average was up 63.50 points or 0.31 percent at 20,449.04. Its September futures were up 60 points at 20,530.
